<!--
Template for calculating gross carbonate production following
Barkley et al. 2023 (NOAA Tech Memo NMFS-PIFSC-154), "Gross carbonate
production calculations" (pp. 7-10) and the colony-level equations in Table 1.

Workflow:
  Step 1  surface cover (x_i) for every colony
  Step 2  attach taxon-specific calcification rates (g_i, d_i, c_i)
  Step 3  colony-level production p_i (Table 1; g CaCO3 yr^-1)
  Step 4  transect-level production P_j (kg CaCO3 yr^-1)
  Step 5  transect-level gross production G_prod,j (kg CaCO3 m^-2 yr^-1)
  Step 6  site-level mean and SD of G_prod
-->
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# libraries
```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse) # dplyr, tidyr, readr, stringr, ggplot2, lubridate
library(here)      # project-relative file paths
library(readxl)
```

# set constants 
```{r constants}
# Number of colony edges for encrusting/plating/foliose/table and laminar
# columnar colonies (Table 1 assumes h = 2)
h_edges <- 2

# Laminar columnar split of surface cover (Table 1): 55% laminar, 45% columnar
## maybe change this slightly?
lc_laminar  <- 0.55
lc_columnar <- 0.45

# Fraction of the published extension rate assumed for non-tip/non-edge growth
off_tip <- 0.1

# IPRB default conversion factor (c_i) for "most branching" corals, used when
# the matched IPRB row has no conversion factor
c_default <- 0.256

# CCA equation choice:
#   "cca"        = all CCA uses p = x * g * d (Table 1 CCA equation; IPRB default) - ignoring morphotype
cca_eq <- "cca"

```

# read csvs
```{r}
corals_raw <- read_csv(here::here("Data", "corals_FP26 - adult_sizes.csv"))

```

# Clean data

```{r clean-data}
corals <- corals_raw |>
  mutate(
    date       = mdy(date),
    across(c(genus, species, morphotype), \(v) str_squish(v)), #removing floating spaces in the text columns
    morphotype = str_to_lower(morphotype),
    # "adult" was entered in the species field for one Cyphastrea record
    species    = na_if(species, "adult"),
    # IPRB taxon names: CCA is listed as "Crustose coralline algae"
    taxon      = if_else(genus == "CCA", "Crustose coralline algae", genus),
    colony_id  = row_number() # unique id so colony-level rows can be traced
  )

# Quick look at what's in the data set
corals |> count(genus, species, morphotype, sort = TRUE)
corals |> distinct(site, transect, date, length)
```

# Step 1: Surface cover (x~i~)

`x_i` is the surface distance (cm) of each colony directly beneath the tape.

- **Open branching**: `x1, x2, ... xn` are all branch diameters measured along
  the transect line, so `x_i = sum(x1:xn)` (NCRMP-leveraged approach, p. 7).
- **All other morphotypes**: `x_i = x1`.
- `c` (colony height, cm) is carried along for reference but is **not** used in
  the Table 1 equations, where `c_i` is the IPRB taxon-specific *conversion
  factor* (proportion of the colony growing axial branches; Step 2).

```{r surface-cover}
corals_x <- corals |>
  mutate(
    x_i = if_else(
      morphotype == "open branching",
      rowSums(pick(matches("^x\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE), # x1 + x2 + ... + xn
      x1
    ),
    # Table 1 equation used for each colony
    morph_code = case_when(
      cca_eq == "cca" & genus == "CCA"                      ~ "cca",
      morphotype %in% c("massive", "mounding", "mounding lobate",
                        "free living")                      ~ "hemisphere",
      morphotype %in% c("encrusting", "plating", "foliose",
                        "table")                            ~ "edge",
      morphotype %in% c("open branching", "closed branching",
                        "columnar")                         ~ "branching",
      morphotype == "laminar columnar"                      ~ "laminar_columnar",
      morphotype == "cca"                                   ~ "cca",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  )

# Any morphotypes that didn't map to an equation? (should be 0 rows)
corals_x |> filter(is.na(morph_code)) |> count(morphotype)
```

# Step 2: Calcification rates (g~i~, d~i~, c~i~) from IPRB v1.3

The IPRB "Calcification Rates" sheet gives one row per **genus × IPRB
morphology** (no species-level rates). Columns used:

| IPRB column                   | here     | meaning                                   |
|-------------------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------|
| `Genera/Taxon`                | `taxon`  | genus (or "Hard coral" generic rows)      |
| `Morphology`                  | `iprb_morph` | IPRB morphology                       |
| `Mean extension rate (cm/yr)` | `g`      | g~i~                                      |
| `Mean density (g/cm3)`        | `d`      | d~i~                                      |
| `Conversion Factor`           | `c_prop` | c~i~ (branching only)                     |

The CCA "extension rate" (0.040) is already a calcification rate in
g cm^-2^ yr^-1^ with no density, so `d` is set to 1 for CCA.

```{r read-iprb-rates}
iprb_rates <- read_excel(here::here("Data", "Indo-Pacific_Carbonate_Production_v1.3-Nov24.xlsx"), 
                         sheet = "Calcification Rates", skip = 9) |>
  select(taxon      = `Genera/Taxon`,
         iprb_morph = Morphology,
         g          = `Mean extension rate (cm/yr)`,
         d          = `Mean density (g/cm3)`,
         c_prop     = `Conversion Factor`) |>
  filter(!is.na(g)) |> # drops non-calcifying categories (sand, turf, etc.)
  mutate(iprb_morph = str_to_lower(iprb_morph),
         d          = if_else(iprb_morph == "cca", 1, d))

```

### Match your morphotypes to IPRB morphologies

Each of our morphotypes gets an ordered list of IPRB morphologies to try (`priority` 1 = first choice). 

Laminar columnar colonies need two sets of rates: the laminar part (`LA`, from plating/foliose rates) and the columnar part (`CO`, from columnar rates). 

Edit this table to change the matching.

```{r morph-crosswalk}
morph_crosswalk <- tribble(
  ~morphotype,         ~part,  ~priority, ~iprb_morph,
  "mounding",          "main", 1,         "massive",
  "mounding",          "main", 2,         "submassive",
  "encrusting",        "main", 1,         "encrusting",
  "closed branching",  "main", 1,         "branching",
  "closed branching",  "main", 2,         "corymbose",  # Acropora has no generic "branching"
  "closed branching",  "main", 3,         "submassive",
  "open branching",    "main", 1,         "branching",
  "open branching",    "main", 2,         "corymbose",
  "laminar columnar",  "LA",   1,         "plating",
  "laminar columnar",  "LA",   2,         "foliose",
  "laminar columnar",  "LA",   3,         "encrusting",
  "laminar columnar",  "CO",   1,         "columnar",
  "laminar columnar",  "CO",   2,         "submassive",
  "laminar columnar",  "CO",   3,         "branching",
  "cca",               "main", 1,         "cca"
)

# CCA rows only match the IPRB "cca" morphology, whatever their morphotype
morph_crosswalk <- morph_crosswalk |>
  bind_rows(
    morph_crosswalk |> distinct(morphotype, part) |> mutate(priority = 99, iprb_morph = "cca")
  )

# Species-specific overrides (tried before the crosswalk), e.g. Acropora growth forms
species_override <- tribble(
  ~genus,     ~species,    ~iprb_morph,
  "Acropora", "globiceps", "digitate"
)
```

### Join rates to colonies

For each colony (and each part, for laminar columnar), keep the
highest-priority IPRB row for its genus. If the genus has no matching row, the
generic IPRB **"Hard coral"** rate for that morphology is used instead
(`priority` + 100, flagged as `rate_level = "Hard coral"`).

```{r join-rates}
candidates <- corals_x |>
  mutate(morphotype = if_else(morph_code == "cca", "cca", morphotype)) |>
  select(colony_id, taxon, genus, species, morphotype) |>
  select(colony_id, taxon, genus, species, morphotype) |>
  inner_join(morph_crosswalk, by = "morphotype", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  bind_rows(
    corals_x |>
      inner_join(species_override, by = c("genus", "species")) |>
      transmute(colony_id, taxon, part = "main", priority = 0, iprb_morph)
  )

matched_rates <- candidates |>
  bind_rows(candidates |> mutate(taxon = "Hard coral", priority = priority + 100)) |>
  inner_join(iprb_rates, by = c("taxon", "iprb_morph")) |>
  slice_min(priority, by = c(colony_id, part), with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(rate_level = if_else(priority >= 100, "Hard coral", "genus")) |>
  select(colony_id, part, iprb_morph, rate_level, g, d, c_prop) |>
  # one row per colony: main rates as g/d/c_prop, laminar columnar as g_LA, g_CO, ...
  pivot_wider(names_from = part,
              values_from = c(iprb_morph, rate_level, g, d, c_prop),
              names_glue = "{.value}_{part}") |>
  rename_with(\(v) str_remove(v, "_main$"))

# get these back into original df
corals_rates <- corals_x |>
  left_join(matched_rates, by = "colony_id") |>
  mutate(
    # branching / columnar colonies need c_i; fall back to the IPRB default
    c_prop    = if_else(morph_code == "branching", coalesce(c_prop, c_default), c_prop),
    c_prop_CO = coalesce(c_prop_CO, c_default)
  )

# Which IPRB rows were used for each taxon x morphotype across the whole dataset
corals_rates |>
  count(genus, morphotype, iprb_morph, rate_level, iprb_morph_LA, iprb_morph_CO)

# Colonies with no rates (should be 0 rows)
corals_rates |>
  filter(if_else(morph_code == "laminar_columnar", is.na(g_LA) | is.na(g_CO), is.na(g))) |>
  count(genus, species, morphotype)
```

# Step 3: Colony-level production (p~i~; Table 1 Barkley et al. 2023)

All equations return g CaCO~3~ yr^-1^ (x in cm, g in cm yr^-1^, d in g cm^-3^).

| code               | Table 1 morphologies                    | equation |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------|----------|
| `hemisphere`       | Massive, Mounding lobate, Free-living   | $p_i = \frac{d_i}{2}\left[\pi\left(g_i + \frac{x_i}{\pi}\right)^2 - \pi\left(\frac{x_i}{\pi}\right)^2\right]$ |
| `edge`             | Encrusting, Plating, Foliose, Table     | $p_i = h g_i d_i + 0.1(x_i g_i d_i)$ |
| `branching`        | Open & closed branching, Columnar       | $p_i = x_i c_i g_i d_i + 0.1 g_i d_i (x_i - x_i c_i)$ |
| `laminar_columnar` | Laminar columnar                        | $p_i = [h g_{LA} d_{LA} + 0.1(0.55x_i g_{LA} d_{LA})] + [0.45x_i c_i g_{CO} d_{CO} + 0.1 g_{CO} d_{CO}(0.45x_i - 0.45x_i c_i)]$ |
| `cca`              | CCA                                     | $p_i = x_i g_i d_i$ |

> **Hemisphere equation:** Table 1 prints this as
> $d_i[(g_i + x_i/\pi)^2(\pi - \pi(x_i/\pi)^2)]$, which isn't dimensionally
> consistent. It's coded as the area between two half-circles of radius
> $r = x_i/\pi$ and $r + g_i$. This matches the IPRB v1.3 "Formulas" sheet
> (e.g. generic massive coral: slope = g·d = 1.089, intercept ≈ πg²d/2).
>
> **Laminar columnar:** Table 1 uses one d~i~; here the laminar and columnar
> parts each use the density from their own IPRB row (identical to Table 1 when
> those densities are equal).

```{r production-functions}

## setting all the equations for the coral morphotypes
p_hemisphere <- function(x, g, d) {
  r <- x / pi
  d * (pi * (r + g)^2 - pi * r^2) / 2
}

p_edge <- function(x, g, d, h = h_edges) {
  h * g * d + off_tip * (x * g * d)
}

p_branching <- function(x, c, g, d) {
  (x * c * g * d) + off_tip * g * d * (x - x * c)
}

p_laminar_columnar <- function(x, c, g_la, d_la, g_co, d_co, h = h_edges) {
  (h * g_la * d_la + off_tip * (lc_laminar * x * g_la * d_la)) +
    p_branching(lc_columnar * x, c, g_co, d_co) # columnar part has the branching form
}

p_cca <- function(x, g, d) {
  x * g * d
}
```

```{r colony-production}
colony_prod <- corals_rates |>
  mutate(
    p_i = case_when(
      morph_code == "hemisphere"       ~ p_hemisphere(x_i, g, d),
      morph_code == "edge"             ~ p_edge(x_i, g, d),
      morph_code == "branching"        ~ p_branching(x_i, c_prop, g, d),
      morph_code == "laminar_columnar" ~ p_laminar_columnar(x_i, c_prop_CO,
                                                            g_LA, d_LA, g_CO, d_CO),
      morph_code == "cca"              ~ p_cca(x_i, g, d)
    )
  )

colony_prod |>
  select(site, transect, genus, species, morphotype, iprb_morph, x_i, p_i) |>
  head(20)
```

# Step 4: Transect-level production (P~j~)

$P_j = \sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i$, converted from g to kg CaCO~3~ yr^-1^.

`n_missing_p` counts colonies with no `p_i` (no matching rates); those
transects will be underestimated.

```{r transect-production}
transect_prod <- colony_prod |>
  group_by(date, site, transect, length) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies  = n(),
    n_missing_p = sum(is.na(p_i)),
    P_j_kg      = sum(p_i, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Step 5: Transect-level gross production (G~prod,j~)

$G_{prod,j} = P_j \left(\frac{10000}{L_j}\right)$, with $L_j$ = transect length
(cm; the `length` column). Units: kg CaCO~3~ m^-2^ yr^-1^.

```{r transect-gprod}
transect_prod <- transect_prod |>
  mutate(G_prod_j = P_j_kg * (10000 / length))

transect_prod
```

# Step 6: Site-level gross production (G~prod~ ± σ)

Mean and standard deviation of $G_{prod,j}$ across transects at each site.
(`sd()` already uses the n − 1 denominator from the report.)

Units; kg CaCO3 m-2 yr-1 (Barkley et al. 2023)

```{r site-gprod}
site_prod <- transect_prod |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    n_transects  = n(),
    G_prod       = mean(G_prod_j),
    G_prod_sd    = sd(G_prod_j),
    n_missing_p  = sum(n_missing_p),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_prod
```

# Plot

```{r plot-site-gprod}
site_prod |>
  filter(!str_starts(site, "Tub_")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(site, G_prod), y = G_prod)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = G_prod - G_prod_sd, ymax = G_prod + G_prod_sd),
                width = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "GCP contribution from corals in Moorea (2026)",
       x = "Site",
       y = expression("Gross carbonate production (kg CaCO"[3]*" m"^-2*" yr"^-1*")")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

#ggsave(here::here("Outputs", "Oct21_gprod_plot.png"), width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
